title: When Movement Breaks a PCB
subject: Electrical engineering
summary: Diagnose intermittent PCB faults caused by mechanical stress.

learning_objectives.text: Explain how mechanical stress creates intermittent solder-joint faults

concepts.label: Solder-joint fatigue
concepts.reference_explanation: Repeated board flex concentrates mechanical stress at solder joints, producing microcracks and intermittent electrical continuity when the board moves.
key_points: Repeated board flex concentrates mechanical stress at solder joints
Microcracks can create intermittent electrical continuity during movement
common_misconceptions: If a circuit works while stationary, solder joints cannot be the problem

concepts.label: Strain relief
concepts.reference_explanation: Strain relief redirects cable forces away from solder joints and reduces repeated flex at the electrical connection.
key_points: Strain relief redirects cable forces away from solder joints
common_misconceptions: More solder always removes mechanical stress
